description: Header file defining structures, enums, and function prototypes for a line editing library used in terminal interfaces.

methods.name: uline_init
methods.description: Initializes the uline_state structure with callback functions, input/output streams, and UTF-8 mode.

methods.name: uline_poll
methods.description: Processes input events for the uline interface.

methods.name: uline_set_line
methods.description: Sets the current input line buffer.

methods.name: uline_set_prompt
methods.description: Sets the prompt string displayed in the line editor.

methods.name: uline_set_line2_prompt
methods.description: Sets the prompt for the secondary line editor.

methods.name: uline_set_hint
methods.description: Provides a hint string for the line editor.

methods.name: uline_hide_prompt
methods.description: Hides the prompt in the line editor.

methods.name: uline_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the uline_state.
